name: desk-asana
description: Claude Code mod that opens your Asana tasks in a side pane (/desk-asana): the tasks assigned to you, a search across the workspace and your projects' tasks by section, with details, comments, adding a comment, assignee, dropdown fields and status. Reads Asana through the Asana MCP server Claude Code already has connected. Pairs with desk-look

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of desk-asana's own labels. auto follows desk-look's language, or Claude Code's language setting in /config without desk-look (Korean when it names Korean, English otherwise)

asanaToken.title: Asana personal access token
asanaToken.description: Optional. Lets the /desk-asana pane edit your own comments and change a task type's status through Asana's REST API (the Asana MCP servers cannot do either). Create one at https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps. Leave empty to keep the pane on MCP only

asanaKeyField.title: Task key field name
asanaKeyField.description: Optional. The name of an Asana custom field, as shown next to its value in a task's details: JKD for a field showing JKD-1630 (not the field's ID; upper or lower case both work). The /desk-asana pane shows that field's value after each task's title, finds a task by it in the search box and adds it to Hand to Claude. Several names separated by commas, the first one a task has a value for wins. Leave empty to show titles only
